title: Creatuwheels
subtitle: Creatures On Wheels Packaging Design
description: The packaging for 'Creatuwheels' brings a playful and educational approach, reflecting the toy’s purpose of teaching geometric shapes and transforming into vehicle-like creatures. From flat layout to assembled box, the design highlights color theory, movement, and imagination.
tileVersion: Toy packaging design exploring geometric play, color theory, and transformation.

highlights.title: Color Blocks
highlights.summary: Cyan, magenta, yellow, and grey—core colors tied to early learning and basic shapes.

highlights.title: Shape Confetti
highlights.summary: Dynamic triangle patterns hint at creativity and play variety.

highlights.title: Iconography
highlights.summary: Outlined abstract figures showcase transformation and movement.

highlights.title: Typography
highlights.summary: Bold logo with tagline 'creatures on wheels' to establish brand identity.

highlights.title: 3D Packaged Product
highlights.summary: Geometric patterns flow seamlessly across the box with space for product info and barcode.

result: Packaging that visually communicates the toy’s creativity, education, and play value—appealing to both kids and adults.

title: Maritime
subtitle: Sculptural Crab Cracker & Packaging Design
description: For 'Maritime', Switch Case Studio reimagined a simple seafood tool into a sculptural dining experience. The crab cracker, inspired by the fluid forms of marine life, balances ergonomic design with aesthetic refinement. Paired with a calm beige and navy packaging system, the project celebrates the art of taste, tactility, and thoughtful presentation.
tileVersion: Product and packaging design inspired by marine forms, balancing function and elegance.

highlights.title: Sculptural Form
highlights.summary: Organic silhouette shaped by ergonomic testing for comfort and balance.

highlights.title: Material Concept
highlights.summary: Envisioned in stainless steel for durability, strength, and refined finish.

highlights.title: Packaging System
highlights.summary: Minimal beige and navy design reflecting the calm sophistication of the sea.

highlights.title: Graphic Language
highlights.summary: Linear wave patterns and typography echo the flow of marine life.

highlights.title: Unboxing Experience
highlights.summary: Inner message crafted to enhance the reveal — transforming function into ritual.

result: A cohesive product and brand experience that transforms a functional utensil into a piece of design storytelling — where form, utility, and emotion converge.
